evidence: Labeled Fuzzing; introduces the new end-to-end fuzz harness src/test/fuzz/p2p_1p1c_liveness.cpp.
rationale: Adds end-to-end fuzz coverage for subtle P2P package relay interactions where mock-based harnesses failed to catch regressions. As noted in commit 3b16af7e7a, without targeted invariants, 'reverting the witnessless-parent fix survived 57k runs' in existing fuzz targets.
